integrity: The theorem is supported by an analytic proof with symbolic and quadrature consistency checks. Finite numerical checks are not presented as proofs of universal statements. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only four consecutive Fourier characters and two equally wide, nonoverlapping, unweighted continuous observation arcs; global optimization for unequal arcs or other band sizes is not established. Literature-priority risk from unindexed exact optimal-design results remains.
title: Antipodal rigidity and a linear spectral cusp for four-mode Fourier observation on two arcs
